dedupe_keys.name: traficom radio and tv stations in finland locations technical data and licences

description: Traficom publishes two registers of broadcast stations in Finland: TV stations and radio stations. For each station they give the name, location, technical data such as frequency or channel, power and antenna details, and licence information such as the licence holder. Both are available through Traficom's OData v4 interface as JSON and as searchable tables on the Traficom website that can be downloaded as text, and they are updated once a day. The datasets have been listed on the Finnish national open data portal since November 2016 under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Coverage: all licensed TV and radio broadcast stations in Finland, including the national DVB-T2 multiplex transmitters and FM stations of Yle and commercial broadcasters. Format and access: JSON via OData v4 and HTML tables with text download, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: licence data describe authorised parameters, not measured coverage; field names are in Finnish. Simulation uses: locating broadcast transmitters to assess their exposure to storms, ice and power outages, and modelling the coverage lost when a main transmitter fails, which matters for public warnings over radio. Related records: the Traficom communications open data record describes the wider interface, and the Ofcom, BNetzA and ČTÚ transmitter data are comparable registers.
name: Traficom radio and TV stations in Finland: locations, technical data and licences
